test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following replaced Pahlaj Nihalani as the Chairperson of Central Board of Film Certification?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prasoon Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prasoon Joshi **replaced **Pahlaj Nihalani **as **Censor Board Chief in 2017**.
 
• **Pahlaj Nihalani**, who turned the **censor board **into a **precinct of serial controversy**, has been **sacked **as **the organization's chairman**.
 
• **His successor **is famous **lyricist-adman Prasoon Joshi**, **while actor Vidya Balan joins the board**.
 
• The **Central Board of Film Certification **is **a statutory film-certification body **in the **Ministry of Information **and **Broadcasting **of the **Government of India**.
 
 
• It is tasked with **"regulating the public exhibition of films under the provisions of the Cinematograph Act 1952."**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sheila Dikshit **was an **Indian politician**. The **longest-serving Chief Minister **of **Delhi**, as well as the **longest-serving female chief minister **of any **Indian state**, she served for **a period of 15 years **beginning in **1998**.
 
• **Jaya Bachchan **is an **Indian actress **and **politician**. She is a **member of Parliament **in the **Rajya Sabha **from the **Samajwadi Party**, **serving four **terms **since 2004**.
 
• **Anupam Kher **is an **Indian actor **and the **former Chairman **of the Film and **Television Institute of India**. He has **appeared **in **over 500 films **predominantly in **Hindi films **and **many plays**. He is a recipient of **two National Film Awards **and **eight Filmfare Awards**.
